config.script:
def getNextChkItemName(baseName, existingNames):
		import re
	    # If base name doesn't exist, return it directly
		if baseName not in existingNames: return baseName
	
		maxNum = 0
		pattern = re.compile(r'^%s(?:\s+(\d+))?$' % re.escape(baseName))
		
		for name in existingNames:
			match = pattern.match(name)
			if match and match.group(1):
				num = int(match.group(1))
				if num > maxNum: maxNum = num
	
		return '%s %d' % (baseName, maxNum + 1)
	
	def getNewChkItemName(chkShtId, chkItemGroupId, chkItemName):
		'''
		This function figures out what we are going to call the new chkItem, by looking at all check items with a similar name and returning then next logical numbered check
		'''
		import re
		baseName = re.sub(r'\s*\d+\s*$', '', chkItemName).strip()
		data = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.quality.config.getChecks({'chkShtId': chkShtId, 'chkItemGroupId': chkItemGroupId, 'chkItemName': baseName + '%'}), 'chkItemName', None)
	
		chkItemNameList = []
		for k,v in data.items():
			chkItemNameList.append(str(v['chkItemName']))
	
		return getNextChkItemName(baseName, chkItemNameList)

	chkItemInfo = dict(self.view.custom.tables.chkItems.selection.data[0])
	newChkItemName = getNewChkItemName(chkItemInfo['chkShtId'], chkItemInfo['chkItemGroupId'], chkItemInfo['chkItemName'])
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	system.kanoa.quality.config.duplicateCheck(chkItemInfo['chkItemId'], newChkItemName, userId)
	change = "Check Item %s duplicated - %s"%(chkItemInfo['chkItemName'], newChkItemName)
	system.kanoa.quality.sheet.addChangeLog({'chkShtId': chkItemInfo['chkShtId'], 'change': change}, userId)
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.changeLog")
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.tables.chkItems.data")
	
	return

if len(self.view.custom.tables.chkItems.selection.data) == 1: msg = "Are you sure you want to delete %s?"%(self.view.custom.tables.chkItems.selection.data[0].chkItemName)
	else: msg = "Are you sure you want to delete the selected checks?"
	
	system.perspective.openPopup("UserConfirmPopup", "kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm",  {'text':msg, 'messageHandler':'deleteCheckItem'}, title='Delete Check Item', modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
	
#	self.view.getChild("root").deleteCheckItem()

customMethods.script:
def norm(v):
		# (Optional) normalize to reduce noisy diffs: treat '' like None, trim strings, etc.
		if (v or None) is None: return None
		# Coerce Java BigDecimal/Long/etc. to Python primitives if needed
		try:
			from java.lang import Number
			if isinstance(v, Number):
				# keep ints as int, decimals as float
				i = int(v)
				if float(v) == float(i): return i
				return float(v)
		except:
			pass
		if isinstance(v, basestring): return v.strip()
		return v

	if self.view.custom.info.chkShtInfo.chkShtVersionStateName == 'Draft': return	# Only log changes to currently released checksheets

	# Ensure plain dicts
	old = dict(compareInfo)     # values currently in DB
	new = dict(chkShtInfo)      # values you intend to save
	
	# Build list of changes
	changes = []
	excludeKeys = ['chkShtVersionStateName', 'chkShtVersion', 'chkShtVersionStateId', 'displayPath', 'masterChkShtId', 'chkShtVersionStateColor']
	
	# Keys present in both: modified?
	for k in set(old.keys()).intersection(new.keys()):
		if k in excludeKeys: continue
		ov = norm(old.get(k))
		nv = norm(new.get(k))
		if ov != nv: changes.append(("modified", k, old.get(k), new.get(k)))
	
	# Keys only in _new: added
	for k in set(new.keys()) - set(old.keys()):
		if k in excludeKeys: continue		
		changes.append(("added", k, None, new.get(k)))
	
	# Keys only in _old: removed
	for k in set(old.keys()) - set(new.keys()):
		if k in excludeKeys: continue		
		changes.append(("removed", k, old.get(k), None))
		
	# If nothing changed, bail out (keeps your early-return behavior)
	if not changes:	return  # Don't save if nothing has changed
	
	# Log each change
	for kind, key, oldVal, newVal in sorted(changes, key=lambda t: t[1].lower() if isinstance(t[1], basestring) else t[1]):
		if (oldVal or None) == (newVal or None): continue
		change = "%s field %s old value: %r new value: %r"%(key, kind, oldVal, newVal)
		system.kanoa.quality.sheet.addChangeLog({'chkShtId': chkShtInfo['chkShtId'], 'change': change}, self.view.custom.security.userId)
	
	return

	system.kanoa.quality.sheet.addTooling(self.view.custom.info.chkShtInfo.chkShtId, toolingIdList, userId)
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.info.tooling")
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Tooling updated'})
	
	change = "Tooling modified: %s"%toolingIdList if len(toolingIdList) else "Tooling removed'
	system.kanoa.quality.sheet.addChangeLog({'chkShtId': chkShtId, 'change': change}, userId)		

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.changeLog")

	return

system.perspective.print("chkShtTypeSelected() msg rcvd by chkShtEditor with %s"%payload)
	
	self.view.custom.info.chkShtInfo.chkShtTypeId = payload['chkShtTypeId']
	self.view.custom.info.chkShtInfo.chkShtTypePath = payload['path']
	
	return
